negative_findings.description: No dedicated Держстат statistical observation on payment instruments, card usage or POS/ATM networks was found. Ukrainian statistical practice appears to leave payment-instrument statistics entirely to the NBU; Держстат touches the topic only indirectly via household expenditure categories and ICT/e-commerce surveys.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in Ukrainian for Держстат + безготівкові розрахунки returned only household budget survey methodology and expenditure aggregates, no payment-statistics observation.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sets expectations: for cell 02, payment statistics are proxies and context, not direct measurement; direct card/POS series must come from the NBU cell.

negative_findings.description: No standalone published АМКУ sectoral market study report specifically on the payment services / acquiring market was located; the substantive market-structure evidence surfaced instead inside case decisions and news releases about the PrivatBank and Oschadbank acquiring cases.
negative_findings.result_summary: Ukrainian-language AMCU search returned news items and a general 'Про проведення досліджень ринків' regulatory index, plus an unrelated market study PDF, but no payments market-study document.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection must target AMCU case decisions and press releases, not a report library, or the acquiring market-share evidence will be missed.

negative_findings.description: Authoritative API documentation for data.gov.ua could not be confirmed. Search results conflicted (one source describes the portal as DKAN-based; an unofficial CKAN mirror exists on GitHub), and no official developer docs page was retrieved.
negative_findings.result_summary: English query for data.gov.ua CKAN API returned mostly US data.gov material plus an unofficial mirror repository.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Machine harvesting of the national catalogue — the main snowball engine for this cell — needs its access contract established before automation is designed.

negative_findings.description: Держстат operates two coexisting domains (stat.gov.ua as the current portal, ukrstat.gov.ua/ukrstat.org as legacy and regional archives). Which content lives where after the migration was not verified, and no URL here has been fetch-tested.
negative_findings.result_summary: Both domains returned live-looking results in search; deep-link stability unknown.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A harvester pinned to one domain risks silent gaps in historical series; deterministic verification pass should test both trees.

coverage_gaps.description: Регіональні головні управління статистики (oblast statistics offices, e.g. cv./od./mk./kyiv.ukrstat.gov.ua) republish and sometimes extend household and retail-trade tables, but were only sampled, not enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate the full set of oblast statistics-office subdomains and test which publish sub-national household expenditure and retail turnover tables usable for regional payment-adoption modelling.

coverage_gaps.description: Other non-NBU public bodies plausibly holding payment-relevant data were not searched in this pass: Держаудитслужба, Рахункова палата (audit of state banks and of cashless programmes), НКЦПФР, Держфінмоніторинг (cash transaction thresholds), and Укрпошта as a cash-distribution and payment agent in rural areas.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a second sweep on these actors with Ukrainian-language queries, especially Рахункова палата audit reports on state banks and Держфінмоніторинг typology reports on cash.

coverage_gaps.description: Public procurement (ProZorro / prozorro.gov.ua and its analytics layer bi.prozorro.org) was not searched, although it is the richest open channel for ATM and POS terminal tenders, quantities, models and prices.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Dedicated pass on ProZorro with CPV codes and Ukrainian terms (банкомат, платіжний термінал, POS-термінал, еквайринг) plus its BI/API endpoints.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language coverage of this cell is thin because these bodies publish primarily in Ukrainian; only the EU portal profile and the Держстат API page were found in English. No English-term equivalents were identified for РРО/ПРРО fiscalisation concepts, which have no clean English analogue.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Treat Ukrainian as the primary collection language for cell 02; maintain a uk-en term map (РРО/ПРРО ≈ fiscal cash register, еквайринг ≈ acquiring, безготівкові розрахунки ≈ cashless settlements) for downstream analysis.

coverage_gaps.description: Several search terms are noisy and degrade automated discovery: 'кешбек' overwhelmingly returns the National Cashback consumer programme rather than payment-market analysis; 'index.minfin.com.ua' is a private site easily mistaken for the Ministry of Finance; 'data.gov' searches in English drift to the US portal.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Constrain automated queries with site: filters on gov.ua domains and pair ambiguous terms with disambiguators (АМКУ, Держстат, ринок, дослідження).

brief: Ukraine's non-central-bank public statistics layer does not measure payments directly — it measures the surrounding economy and the digitalisation programmes that drive payment behaviour. The load-bearing sources are Держстат (household budget survey separating cash, non-cash subsidy and in-kind expenditure; ICT and e-commerce surveys; a new stat.gov.ua portal with a development API alongside the ukrstat.gov.ua archive), data.gov.ua as the national catalogue and the single best snowballing hub, and the ДПС RRO/PRRO fiscalisation statistics as the closest public proxy for POS acceptance points. The sharpest payment-market intelligence outside the NBU comes from the АМКУ, whose acquiring and issuing case decisions disclose issuer market shares and merchant-fee reasoning that no statistical publication contains; Мінфін (state-bank reporting), ФГВФО (deposit aggregates and bank exits), Мінцифра/Дія (regional digital transformation index, National Cashback) and Є-data/spending.gov.ua (transaction-level state procurement of payment infrastructure) fill in ownership, adoption and infrastructure angles. Everything here publishes primarily in Ukrainian, so uk-language querying is not optional; the main untested channels remain ProZorro procurement and the audit/financial-monitoring bodies.
